Thus, the name Roja can be seen as a reflection of the divine feminine and is believed to bestow its bearer with the strength, sustenance, and blessings of the Goddess within. Hindu mythology sustains various tales about feminine deities or devis, such as Parvati, Shakti, Lakshmi, and Kali, who are associated with the color red. Roja, as a name, is believed to have spiritual significance as it invokes the blessings of these divine feminine energies.

She is remembered for her devotion to Hinduism and her support of the arts and learning.
